title: Inovio Pharmaceuticals (INO) 发布VOCERYQ并启动商业销售
originalTitle: Inovio Pharmaceuticals, Inc. (INO) Discusses FDA Accelerated Approval and Commercial Launch of VOCERYQ for RRP Transcript
summary: Inovio Pharmaceuticals (INO)宣布VOCERYQ通过FDA加速审批并启动商业销售。公司CEO Jacqui Shea、CMO Mike Sumner、CCO Steve Egge将在电话会议中介绍产品获批细节、标签信息及商业化计划。
